subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork fix for GitHub Copilot auth-order selection, or close that candidate and leave this issue pending?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but a linked open fork PR already claims the fix and is conflicting, so automation should not open a competing repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork fix
options.body: Review the fork PR's approach, then either rebase/adopt it or open a narrow target-repo replacement that preserves the source PR credit.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and provide updated proof.

options.title: Close the candidate PR path
options.body: Close the linked candidate as no longer useful and leave this issue open for a future maintainer-sponsored fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the fork fix
recommendation.body: Review the fork PR's approach, then either rebase/adopt it or open a narrow target-repo replacement that preserves the source PR credit.
